name: google-imagen
description: Google image generation via the Gemini API (Nano Banana models; Imagen is shut down): generate and edit images, saved to a local folder (paid per image)

nodes.title: List models
nodes.description: List Gemini API models available to the key (image models have image in their name)

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, to get the next page

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get model
nodes.description: Metadata of one model: version, token limits, supported actions

model.description: Model id without the models/ prefix, e.g. gemini-nano-banana-2.1

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Generate image
nodes.description: Generate an image from a prompt with a Gemini image model (paid, SynthID-watermarked). Saved to $GOOGLE_IMAGEN_OUTPUT_DIR; pass previous_interaction_id to edit the image of an earlier call

prompt.description: What to generate, or the change to make to the previous interaction's image

model.description: Image model, e.g. gemini-nano-banana-2.1 (default), gemini-3.1-flash-image, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, gemini-3-pro-image

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio (1:4, 4:1, 1:8, 8:1 only on Nano Banana 2.1 and 3.1 Flash)

image_size.description: Output size (512 only on 3.1 Flash Image); larger costs more

previous_interaction_id.description: Continue a previous interaction (multi-turn editing of its image) by its id

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Create interaction
nodes.description: Low-level Interactions API call with content blocks (text, base64 or URI images) for image generation or editing (paid). Generated images are saved to $GOOGLE_IMAGEN_OUTPUT_DIR

model.description: Image model, e.g. gemini-nano-banana-2.1 (default), gemini-3.1-flash-image, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, gemini-3-pro-image

previous_interaction_id.description: Continue a previous interaction (multi-turn editing of its image) by its id

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get interaction
nodes.description: A stored interaction with its steps; images in it are saved to $GOOGLE_IMAGEN_OUTPUT_DIR

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Gemini API request
nodes.description: Call any Gemini API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/v1beta/models". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/v1beta/models"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Edit image
nodes.description: Edit or combine up to 14 images with a prompt using a Gemini image model (paid). Images: https URLs or files inside $GOOGLE_IMAGEN_UPLOAD_DIR. The result is saved like generate_image

prompt.description: The edit to make, e.g. Put a party hat on the cat

images.description: Input images: https URLs or absolute paths inside $GOOGLE_IMAGEN_UPLOAD_DIR (20 MB in total once base64-encoded, about 15 MB of files)

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio (default: from the input)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
